cwe_content.cwe: CWE-668,Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

candidate.Reason: This method decrypts and returns the plaintext password using the GoCipher instance, exposing the decrypted secret to the calling code. In the context of authenticated agents, this could allow a malicious/compromised agent to access the decryption key and decrypt secrets intended for other agents.
This method calls getPassword() which internally calls currentPassword(), potentially exposing decrypted secrets to command line execution context where they could be intercepted by malicious agents.
Directly exposes the decrypted password by calling currentPassword(), making sensitive credentials available to any code with access to this method, including potentially compromised agents.
